# Discovery narration: no PR token, origin `acme/widgets`

No continuation record, run folder or plan tracker exists yet. Discovery runs during argument resolution, before set routing. So no tracker stages are initialized and nothing is verified or assessed in any of these runs.

## Main run

1. **Resolve origin.** `git remote get-url origin` gives `acme/widgets`, a GitHub repository.
2. **Read identity.**
   - `gh api user --jq .login` gives `viewer.login = alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '...'` gives `viewer.teams = []`.
3. **List open PRs awaiting my review.** The `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 ...` block exits 0. Its output is a valid array of six objects, each with an integer `number`. Six is below the 1000 limit, so the list is complete.
4. **Filter.**
   - Drop #31 because it is a draft.
   - Drop #38 because it is already approved.
   - #19, #22 and #27 survive with changes requested and need a review lookup.
   - #40 (review required) is kept without a lookup.
5. **Review lookups, one at a time, in ascending PR number.**
   - #19: `gh api graphql ...` lookup block exits 0 with stdout `answered`. Keep.
   - #22: lookup block exits 0 with stdout `unanswered`. Exclude it from both the list and the gated set.
   - #27: lookup block exits 0 with stdout `answered`. Keep.
6. **Sort by additions plus deletions, then number.**
   - #40: 3
   - #27: 5
   - #19: 9
7. **Ticket display.**
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolves the default branch.
   - `git show <ref>:<path>` reads the overrides file in search order, which gives `tracker: github`. That setting disables Linear IDs and lookups.
   - No PR has closing references. The branch `widget` and the titles carry no `gh-<N>` or `#<N>`, and there are no Linear addresses. Each entry therefore shows `no ticket`.
8. **Next step.** Two or more PRs matched on pi, so discovery re-enters set routing with `source: discovered`. The list goes in the visible text of the reply that carries the next tool call, which is the read of `reference/batch.md`. That reply has no marker and does not wait for an answer.

What the user reads:

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#40](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/40) +3 -0, by jo, requested from you, no ticket - sorts widgets
- [#27](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/27) +5 -0, by jo, requested from you, no ticket - restores widget colors
- [#19](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/19) +9 -0, by jo, requested from you, no ticket - shows widget names

Tokens sent to set routing, in this order, with `source: discovered`:
1. `https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/40`
2. `https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/27`
3. `https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/19`

The narration stops here, before set admission, gathering or provisioning.

## Isolated run: failed call

Steps 1-4 match the main run. The first lookup is for #19, and `gh` exits 1 with empty stdout. Discovery stops before listing or routing, so the lookups for #22 and #27 never run and no list is printed.

What the user reads:

gauntlet: stuck discovery failed: HTTP 502: Bad Gateway

discovery failed: HTTP 502: Bad Gateway

## Isolated run: unreadable lookup

Steps 1-4 match the main run. The #19 lookup block prints `malformed` and exits 1. Discovery stops with no further lookups, no list and no routing.

What the user reads:

gauntlet: stuck discovery failed: malformed review lookup for #19

discovery failed: malformed review lookup for #19

## Isolated run: incomplete lookup

Steps 1-4 match the main run. The #19 lookup block prints `incomplete` and exits 1. Discovery stops with no further lookups, no list and no routing.

What the user reads:

gauntlet: stuck discovery failed: incomplete review lookup for #19

discovery failed: incomplete review lookup for #19

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Before ran no review lookups, excluded all three changes-requested PRs, listed only #40 under an unbolded singular heading, and treated the three isolated runs as no-ops, so every fact failed there. After moves all five: the wording that keeps changes-requested PRs pending a per-PR lookup produced lookups for #19, #22 and #27 only, in ascending order, with none for the draft #31, approved #38 or undecided #40 (f1); the bold `**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**` heading with linked #40, #27, #19 and the same three tokens routed in that order, with #22 excluded as unanswered (f2); and each failure run stops with the exact `discovery failed: ...` line, using only the first stderr line for the 502, with no list and no routing (f3-f5). Nothing Before held was lost. One thing to tighten: each failure run prints the message twice, once as `gauntlet: stuck discovery failed: ...` and once bare; if the stuck marker line and the plain stop line are meant to be a single output, say which form the user sees so the stop text is not duplicated, and keep the explicit statements that later lookups do not run and no list is printed, since those are what make f3-f5 readable from the text.
